brief:
Settlers attacked five Palestinians, including elderly residents and young men, near the western entrance to Mughayyir village in the West Bank, Eye on Palestine reported. More than ten assailants beat the victims as they made their way to attend a funeral gathering in the village.

The assault targeted mourners heading to pay condolences for casualties in Mughayyir. The attackers used physical force against the group traveling to the ceremony. No information was available regarding the extent of injuries sustained or the specific identities of those who were beaten during the incident.
